stemMd: What change followed the volunteer’s observation?

options.label: A
options.textMd: It made all opening hours identical to customer preferences.

options.label: C
options.textMd: The cooperative introduced a refundable container deposit.

options.label: D
options.textMd: It removed the refill station permanently.

options.label: E
options.textMd: It raised every refill price above bottled prices.

explanationMd: The second paragraph directly identifies the refundable deposit as the next intervention. The experiment changed the up-front commitment rather than removing the refill option. Opening hours remained a separate constraint.

distractorRationale.b: The change was designed to make refills more accessible.
distractorRationale.d: Refill use increased after the change.
distractorRationale.a: Inconvenient hours remained a reason some preferred bottles.
